verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub confirm a block-based editor (text, databases, kanban, calendar, custom Types) and community reports confirm tables exist (though 'simple, no formulas'), plus templates and page icons/covers. However there is no explicit evidence for headings, callouts, or code blocks as first-class formatting elements, nor any documentation of keyboard shortcuts or 'fast keyboard-driven' editing speed, and embedded media support is only implied via cover images. missing for 10: explicit callout/heading/code-block support, documented keyboard-shortcut system, and evidence of rich embedded media (video/audio/files) in the editor.
